feeds.title: My OpenShift Blog
feeds.description: The blog features many helpful tips and tricks related to red hat openshift. My Openshift Blog is an independent publication and a personal blog launched by Keith Calligan.

feeds.title: Upstream - Without A Paddle
feeds.description: This site is dedicated to sharing the work that I do in my home lab. I am a huge fan of cloud native application delivery on Kubernetes based platforms. I specifically focus on OpenShift Container Platform, and its subscription free (community supported) sibling, OKD.

feeds.title: OpenShift Official Blog
feeds.description: Red Hat OpenShift is an open-source container application platform based on the Kubernetes container orchestrator for enterprise application development and deployment.
